claim: Available seats update after a sample booking.
where: Demo booking confirmation and capacity rail
sandbox: Fresh /demo?demo=1 context; book one seat and assert the visible count changes from two open to one.

claim: A full sample class cannot accept another booking.
sandbox: Fresh demo; submit the full class and assert both UI and API block it.

claim: A sample class past its cutoff cannot accept bookings.
sandbox: Fresh demo; open the cutoff class and assert no booking can be created.

claim: Demo changes stay in sample data and reset.
sandbox: Two contexts; book and reset in one, then assert both return seed availability.

claim: A school can publish a class, reconcile its count, and convert a released seat from the waitlist.
where: School workspace, public booking, and offer pages
sandbox: Signed-in test owner uses every visible form, including waitlist and selected cancellation, then accepts the offer.

claim: An encrypted iCalendar feed is checked every five minutes.
where: School calendar connection and privacy page
sandbox: Connect a recorded iCalendar fixture, inspect ciphertext at rest, then run the due worker at now, now+299 seconds, and now+300 seconds.

claim: Without SMTP, staff get a durable one-click released-seat offer, a Copy offer action, and a delivery receipt that says no email was sent.
sandbox: Fresh signed-in workspace with no SMTP; cancel a booking for a waitlisted guardian, copy the offer, reload, and assert the same usable URL and no-email receipt remain.

claim: The school plan costs $99 each month.
where: Landing facts, signed-out workspace, billing section, and terms
sandbox: Intercept the Sociobot API, assert the product creates the checkout with POST, and assert navigation reaches its hosted Dodo URL.

claim: There are no advertising trackers or analytics scripts.
sandbox: Record all requests through landing, demo, privacy, and signed-in workspace flows; assert every request is same-origin.

claim: School guardian contact fields are encrypted at rest and erased after 90 days.
sandbox: Inspect persisted rows for absent plaintext, advance the clock to the exact 90-day boundary, and assert contact fields are scrubbed.

claim: School staff use Sociobot Entra sign-in and server-side roles.
sandbox: Use the recorded identity, assert viewer access succeeds, and assert the same viewer is forbidden from an owner action.

claim: Workspace owners can export or delete school data.
where: Workspace data controls and privacy page
sandbox: Create a signed-in workspace, download its JSON export, confirm deletion, and assert the workspace is gone.

claim: Demo name and email input is discarded, and each demo expires after 24 hours.
sandbox: Fresh temporary database; submit distinctive demo input, inspect stored placeholders, advance to the exact 24-hour boundary, and assert cascade deletion.

claim: A calendar discrepancy never changes confirmed seats automatically.
sandbox: Fresh workspace and class; reconcile a different calendar count and assert the discrepancy is recorded while confirmed and open seats stay unchanged.

claim: Committed capacity changes survive a container restart.
sandbox: Fresh release process with a separate direct mounted /data directory; create a real school, publish a class, book a seat, restart the process, and assert the changed seat count, decrypted booking, SQLite file, and generated keys remain.

claim: A configured SMTP relay queues an encrypted released-seat offer for delivery.
sandbox: Create a capacity-one class with a waiting guardian under SMTP configuration; release the seat and assert an encrypted pending outbox record contains the offer URL.

claim: A staff member can recover the same workspace on another device after sign-in.
sandbox: Create a workspace for a recorded stable staff oid, omit its device-local access key, and resolve the workspace again from that oid.

claim: A released seat creates a 24-hour offer for the oldest waiting guardian.
sandbox: Create two ordered waiting entries, release a confirmed booking, and assert the first encrypted email is selected with expiry exactly 86,400 seconds later.

claim: The container starts with only PORT and generates persisted local keys when no key variables are supplied.
sandbox: Build the release binary, start it with only PATH, PORT, and its static frontend path, then assert health and generated-default/persisted-key startup logs.

claim: Rate limits use the forwarded client IP and return Retry-After when the allowance is exhausted.
sandbox: Use one forwarded IP through a two-request allowance, assert a 429 with Retry-After, then prove a second forwarded IP has its own allowance.

claim: Production uses one replica with Azure Files for SQLite data and generated keys.
sandbox: Begin with verification-16's exact active candidate shape (revision 0000046, image 283758f64e32, one PORT variable, no /data mount, no volume, and maxReplicas 3); assert the readback verifier rejects it, then run the deploy command through the recorded Azure control-plane fixture and assert it applies the work-order Azure Files /data mount, reads back exactly one replica, and verifies the full runtime build identity.

claim: Signed-in owners and operators can inspect aggregate service and capacity metrics without guardian data.
where: School workspace operations page and README operations section
sandbox: Create a test-owner workspace with one discrepancy; assert unauthenticated metrics access is challenged, then assert the protected Prometheus response includes request/error/latency, calendar lag, discrepancy, and offer conversion values without school, class, identity, guardian, or email text.
